skill.name: stripe-agent
skill.description: Guides Stripe billing operations for Unite-Hub, including products, prices, checkout sessions, subscriptions, webhooks, and test versus live billing modes.
skill.summary: Manage Stripe billing setup, subscription workflows, checkout sessions, webhook operations, and billing audits for Unite-Hub.
skill.author: CleanExpo

security_audit.summary: All 78 static findings were adjudicated. The backtick, hardcoded URL, and secret-key hits are documentation examples or placeholders, not executable code or leaked credentials. The remaining concerns are semantic: live billing, webhook, and secret-handling workflows need stronger approval and verification guardrails.

remediation.issue: Live billing changes lack an explicit approval gate.
remediation.suggestion: Require clear human confirmation before creating, updating, canceling, or syncing live Stripe products, prices, customers, subscriptions, and checkout sessions.

remediation.issue: Webhook processing does not explicitly require signature verification.
remediation.suggestion: Add a required step to verify Stripe webhook signatures with the correct mode-specific webhook secret before changing subscription or workspace state.
Tell agents to check only presence or redacted prefixes for Stripe keys and to never print full API keys, webhook secrets, or payment data.

semantic_findings.title: Live Billing Operations Need Explicit Approval
semantic_findings.description: The skill directs agents to create Stripe products, prices, checkout sessions, customers, and subscription changes, including live mode for real customers. It does not document an explicit human approval gate before high-impact billing changes.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file explicitly states that the skill manages all Stripe billing operations and lists create/update workflows. I found no approval checkpoint in the documented live billing flow.

semantic_findings.title: Webhook State Changes Need Verification Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The webhook workflow handles events that activate, update, or deactivate subscription access. The documented steps do not state that Stripe signatures must be verified before changing account state.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill lists webhook events and endpoint secrets, but the workflow omits an explicit signature verification step. The risk is high because these events control subscription entitlements.

semantic_findings.title: Secret Handling Guardrails Are Missing
semantic_findings.description: The skill lists test and live Stripe secret variables and includes configuration audits, but it does not instruct agents to redact secret values or avoid printing secrets in reports.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file documents secret variable names and audit outputs but does not include redaction rules. This is an absence-based finding, so confidence is high enough to flag but not absolute.

content.value_statement: Stripe billing setup can be difficult to keep consistent across test and live modes. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through products, subscriptions, checkout, webhooks, and billing audits.
actual_capabilities: Plans Stripe products and monthly or annual prices for defined Unite-Hub tiers.
Creates checkout session workflows with customer email, tier, billing interval, and workspace metadata.
Explains test versus live billing mode routing for staff and customer accounts.
Documents subscription upgrade, downgrade, cancellation, invoice, and customer management tasks.
Reviews webhook endpoint setup and billing configuration health checks.
Summarizes billing reports with revenue, subscription, trial, and churn metrics.
limitations: Requires a configured Stripe MCP server and valid Stripe account permissions.
Does not replace production code review for payment, tax, or entitlement logic.
Should not perform live billing changes without explicit human approval.
Uses Unite-Hub pricing and routing assumptions that may not fit other products.

use_cases.title: Set up SaaS billing tiers
use_cases.description: Define Stripe products, prices, and checkout flows for Starter, Professional, and Elite plans.

use_cases.title: Audit billing configuration
use_cases.description: Check required environment variables, webhook registration, product parity, and missing setup steps.

use_cases.title: Investigate subscription state
use_cases.description: Review customer subscriptions, invoice status, plan changes, and workspace entitlement sync needs.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Test Products
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me set up Stripe products and prices for Starter, Professional, and Elite tiers in test mode first. List the IDs I must store.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Checkout Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a checkout plan for this user email, tier, billing interval, workspace ID, and user ID. Choose test or live mode and explain why.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Stripe Configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit our Stripe billing setup. Check required variables, products, prices, webhook registration, and parity between test and live mode.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile Billing State
prompt_templates.prompt: Review a failed webhook or subscription mismatch. Compare Stripe status, workspace tier, invoice state, and recommended sync actions without exposing secrets.

output_examples.input: Audit Stripe setup for production readiness.
output: Test mode products and prices are present for all tiers.
Live webhook registration needs confirmation before launch.
Store missing live webhook secret in the production environment.

output_examples.input: Create checkout for an internal staff email on the Professional monthly plan.
output_examples.output: The workflow selects test mode, creates or reuses the customer, attaches Professional monthly pricing, and returns the checkout session link.
The report summarizes recurring revenue by tier, new subscriptions, churned subscriptions, active trials, conversions, and failed payment follow-up items.

best_practices: Run all setup and checkout tests in Stripe test mode before touching live billing.
Require human approval for live product, price, subscription, cancellation, and webhook changes.
Redact secret keys, webhook secrets, customer IDs, and payment details in all reports.
anti_patterns: Running live billing setup from vague or incomplete prompts.
Mixing test price IDs, live price IDs, and customer records across modes.
Logging full Stripe secrets, webhook payloads, or payment identifiers in chat.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It guides Stripe products, prices, checkout sessions, subscriptions, invoices, customers, webhooks, and billing audits.

faq.question: Can it work with live Stripe billing?
faq.answer: Yes, but live billing changes should require explicit human confirmation and correct Stripe permissions.

faq.question: Does it store Stripe secrets?
faq.answer: No. Secrets should stay in environment management tools and should be redacted in chat output.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it limited to Unite-Hub?
faq.answer: The examples use Unite-Hub tiers, URLs, and routing assumptions. Other products need adaptation.

faq.question: Does it verify webhook security?
faq.answer: It references webhook secrets, but implementers should add explicit Stripe signature verification steps.
